name: Omnimon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Omnimon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, choose 1 of both players' Digimon and delete all other Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) for the turn and attack without suspending.
